statement: Let G be the graph on vertices 0,...,15 encoded by the standard graph6 string O???CB?wB@F?@o@oB_?s?. Then G is connected, simple, cubic, and has order 16. The coloring serialized in evidence/order16/counterexample_g044.json is a proper total coloring of G with four colors, while G has no equitable proper total coloring with four colors. Consequently chi''(G)=4 and G is an exact counterexample of order strictly less than 20 to the universal assertion frozen in source.md.
contribution: An exact order-16 counterexample with a directly checkable proper 4-total coloring and a clause-for-clause reconstructed equitable-coloring CNF whose text DRAT refutation is checked by a separate standard-library implementation. This disproves the frozen original statement. No claim that order 16 is minimum, or that the counterexample is novel in the literature, is submitted.
